h:
这是我个人的 ComfyUI 制作这些毛茸茸的图像的工作流程。根据我的理解，我倾向于中间点，其中工作流程不太简单也不太复杂。除了组旁路之外，也没有许多组织器节点，因此电线在画布周围晃来晃去。

我的目标是使用舒适并且仍然拥有像 A1111 这样的元数据，这就是我使用“Image-Saver”自定义节点和其他一些自定义节点的原因。

我也利用https://civitai.com/models/661484/ai-image-metadata-editor编辑元数据并使其更加精确。我不会对每张照片都这样做，只会对那些我感到最自豪的照片这样做。

o.en:
This is my personal ComfyUI workflow for making those furry images. In my understanding I lean towards a middle point in which the workflow is not too simple and not too complex. Also without many of those organizer nodes besides group bypass, so the wires are dangling all around the canvas.

My aim is to use comfy and still have metadata like A1111, that's why I make use of "Image-Saver" custom node and some other custom nodes.

I also make use ofhttps://civitai.com/models/661484/ai-image-metadata-editorto edit the metadata and make it more precise. I don't do this to every image, only to those I feel most proud of.
